summary: MoonLake Immunotherapeutics filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose that on September 30, 2026 it submitted a Biologics License Application to the U.S. FDA seeking approval of sonelokimab, a tri-specific nanobody, for moderate-to-severe hidradenitis suppurativa in adults and pediatric patients aged 12 and older. The company expects FDA acceptance notification within roughly 60 days and the planned review timeline within about 74 days. No deal, stakeholder, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated. This is an ordinary regulatory milestone, not a special situation; watch FDA acceptance and PDUFA timing as the catalyst.
